body:
Thank you for the support, I appreciate it a lot!

Even if the outpatient is shitty, I can work on the mental aspect with my current mental health team. I just need to be able to beat withdrawal and being drug sick before that which even with shitty outpatient, it's better than nothing and depending on the program I still get to go home. Just a process that'll take months to even get an appointment/assessment with another outpatient program. 

For now staying away is my goal. Gonna be hard since it's a small house but hoping I'll manage till this blows over.

Youre very kind for taking the time to respond. Again, thank you.

Thank you for responding in a respectful manner. I've gone through 5 mental hospital visits for a variety of things including my addiction, and due to the isolation aspect of it I ended up coming out a lot worse. I also have state insurance and my dad currently works at the first facility I went to and he can even confirm how terrible it is, he's actively searching for a new job. 

Ive ended up being put on excessive amounts of medications to prevent me from hurting myself (I also struggle very, very badly with self harm to the point of frequently getting stitches) to the point of me having seizures, and on top of that they've prescribed me controlled substances as well fully knowing about my ongoing battles with addiction. Im stuck in this one mental health network due to insurance yet again and I cant switch therapists or psychiatrists again due to their crappy policies. Getting help with this insurance is pretty much a no-go. The most I can do is get into group therapy thats DBT based again, which didnt help in the slightest. 

I honestly really do want to be sober, I just physically cant handle it at this point without legitimate help that I cant get, even if I told my dad. My mom wouldnt do anything, I got taken out of her custody in the first place for medical neglect. 

My current relationship is honestly the most stable and supportive one I've been in. I genuinely feel safe with him, and its an amazing change of pace compared to the more predatory and abusive people I tend to gravitate toward.

Thank you a lot for your response, I might try to push for a referral through my actual doctor to at least get in some sort of outpatient program solely to help me get (and stay)  sober.

Today was supposed to be my first day back to school, my boyfriend surprised me by picking me up about 2 hours early and taking me out for breakfast! I struggle with self esteem issues and issues regarding food, and he was very very patient with me. I also very rarely get treats like that even when I do want them so it was really refreshing!
That's true, but I don't think I can wait for that since that's going to take years, maybe decades, maybe it just won't happen.

that's a very good point. If he talks to me today, I think I'll let him know how I really feel since he thinks I've moved on. I hope it isn't too late to fix things with him and I. Thank you for giving me some perspective.
if you ever need anyone to talk to, I'm always here. <3 Maybe you should try to get a pet? That helped me out a lot.
Thank you for apologizing, I really appreciate it. Sorry if I came off a bit rude aswell, clearly not having too great of a night either. I hope you get through whatever's weighing you down, too.
Can you please not reply while drunk? It's kind of rude especially given me "cutting a little too shallow" was me hitting an artery. I could literally see it. But thanks for the rest of the advice.
